summary: Seagate (STX) reported Q3 FY26: $3.1B revenue (+44% YoY), non-GAAP gross margin 47% (all-time high). WDC outperforms with $3.3B (+45% YoY) and 50%+ GM. HDD duopoly (WDC ~45%, Seagate ~40%+) with 2026 capacity fully committed. Micron's NAND blowout validates storage supercycle. WDC divested SanDisk in Feb 2026 for $3.1B - now pure-play HDD. Competitive threat: future 3D-NAND cost breakthrough could threaten warm-storage HDD demand.
